description: HRU: ancla de evidencia de bases para claims del asistente. Fail-closed: synthetic nunca es verified.

quality_rules.verified: page>=1 AND snippet_len>=min_snippet AND not synthetic AND (optional corpus verify pass)
quality_rules.document_only: source_name present AND (page missing OR snippet weak) AND not synthetic
quality_rules.synthetic: fabricated page/snippet (legacy chat fallback); treat as insufficient for claims
